question: He's been trained to hone his special talents, but has he had any opportunity to teach, or be taught by, mercenaries who have taught themselves how to fight?
answer: Julius' way of fighting has been trained to be most appropriate for a knight, so if he learned the rough fighting style of the mercenaries, it might ruin his balance. The mercenaries, too, have survived this far by the way they fight, so I think they probably wouldn't want any odd ideas mixed in. On both sides, they've learned how their opponents kill, wouldn't you think?
